purpose: Capture forward, timestamped multi-agent research decisions before outcomes are known.
rules: A shadow record is frozen before its outcome window begins.
Frozen research payload hashes must match at resolution.
Outcome resolution cannot mutate the original research snapshot.
Records with stale/unavailable critical evidence are VOID or explicitly degraded.
Forward evidence is separated from historical replay evidence.
Resolved shadow observations may feed Agent Alpha.
No component has real-money execution authority.
